subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR22: 'If automatic locking has been specified for the write file, neither the WITH LOCK phrase nor the WITH NO LOCK phrase shall be specified.' (--check OK). CheckRecordLockPhrase is called BEFORE the sequential/keyed reroute, so both arms are covered: LOCK MODE AUTOMATIC + WRITE WITH LOCK -> COBOL1512 (ws2auto), + WITH NO LOCK -> 1512 (ws2auton), relative dynamic file + WITH NO LOCK -> 1512 (ws2autorel). MANUAL mode admits all four spellings (ws2lock). With no LOCK MODE clause the phrase is accepted (ws2nolm) - automatic locking has not been 'specified'. read-auto-with-lock is READ's twin; no test pins the WRITE arm, so test-ref is empty. [editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the lock phrases do not exist in 1985 - rejected there with COBOL0900)]
